'''Dongrang''' is a researcher at K Corp. and a former member of the [[League of Nine]]. He appears as a major figure in [[Canto IV]].

== Background ==
Dongrang once worked alongside [[Yi Sang]] in the League of Nine Littérateurs. After the League collapsed, their paths diverged. Dongrang later became involved in K Corp.'s research, including work connected to the [[Mirror]].

== Canto IV ==
During Canto IV, Dongrang's history with Yi Sang is established, including their former collaboration and the break that followed the League's dissolution.
